title: Today
note: Hero = kcal left. One buddy dialogue holds the day’s one prompt. Three rows.

title: Today · check-in due
note: Same slot, another prompt: on check-in day the buddy asks this instead. Never both.

title: Today in detail (sheet)
note: Tapping the hero. Replaces the old LEFT / EATEN switch and the Details link.

title: Log weight (sheet)
note: One weigh sheet for the whole app: the buddy, Progress and the shortcut all open it.

title: Recovery
note: From the Recovery row. Sleep and readiness from Google Health.

title: Talk to Chompers
note: Opened from the buddy (Today dialogue or Play). The same dialogue box, as a conversation.

title: Log food
note: Opens on the meal for this hour, search focused, barcode inside the field. Recents ranked for this meal; + logs the usual amount and keeps the sheet open.

title: Search results
note: Typed “chicken th”. + logs the usual amount and the sheet stays open for the next food; tapping the name opens the amount screen.

title: Barcode
note: From the barcode button in the search field: one tap, straight to the camera.

title: Quick add
note: Calories and macros directly. One serving, so there is no amount step.

title: Estimate (AI)
note: Describe, photograph or paste a menu link. Menu is now an input here, not a separate tab.

title: Drink
note: Alcohol in units and kcal. Recent drinks first.

title: Food detail / amount
note: Tapping a result’s name. The amount, what it does to today, and Log.

title: Edit entry
note: Tapping a diary row. Copy, move and delete live here (the per-row ≡ menu goes).

title: Log food · first time
note: No history yet: the chips and search carry it; one line says recents will appear.

title: Diary
note: One summary line, then meals as sections and entries as rows. Tap a row to edit; + on each meal.

title: Meal actions (sheet)
note: Tapping a meal’s name. The meal’s existing ⋯ menu, as rows: copy, save, reorder, clear, delete.

title: Diary · empty day
note: A new day. Meals stay as sections so the + is where you expect it.

title: Cook
note: Cook lives inside Food. Hero = the recipe that fits what’s left today. Your recipes, then four rows.

title: Recipe detail
note: Per serving at the top, ingredients and method as plain lists, Log in the footer.

title: Recipe builder
note: Build from ingredients. The per-serving numbers update as you go and sit in the footer.

title: Import a recipe (sheet)
note: Paste a link from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or a recipe site, or photograph a page.

title: Meal plan
note: The week’s dinners. Gaps are rows you can fill; the list feeds the shopping list.

title: Shopping list
note: Grouped by aisle. Tick as you go.

title: Discover
note: Community recipes, filtered to what fits you. Your contributor level moves to the foot.

title: What can I make?
note: After the fridge photo: what it saw, then recipes that fit what’s left today.

title: Cook · no recipes
note: Two ways in, both on the screen. Discover stays a row.

title: Today · first day
note: Before hatching: the egg wobbles in the bar, the egg speaks, and a three-step checklist replaces the Today rows.

title: Train
note: Hero = next session with Start. 17 internal screens become four places: this, Session, History, Block.

title: Session (before Start)
note: Preview and player are one screen: this is the session before Start. Tap an exercise to swap it.

title: Live session
note: One exercise in the window, a PREVIOUS column you can tap to copy, the rest timer in place. No tab bar.

title: Session done
note: The buddy reacts once, in the dialogue box. Records sit under it as rows.

title: History · sessions
note: Sessions and Lifts in one place (was History + Progress + Exercise).

title: History · lifts
note: Every exercise you’ve logged, best first. Tap for its detail.

title: Session detail
note: A past session: totals, then each exercise as a row with its sets.

title: Exercise detail
note: Best and trend in the hero, then recent sessions. How-to is one row.

title: Block & schedule
note: One page for the block: weeks, the days you train, and every block-level action (was 8 screens).

title: New block (flow)
note: Wizard, draft and builder become one short flow. Step 2 of 4 shown; answers are a ▶ menu.

title: Exercise picker (sheet)
note: The library is a picker inside a session or the builder, not its own screen.

title: Train · no block yet
note: One action: build a block. An empty session stays one tap away.

title: Progress
note: The plan’s one home (MacroFactor’s Strategy). Hero = verdict + trend. Plan rows, then More.

title: Check-in · 1 your week
note: A short paged flow. A quiet week is this page and the last.

title: Check-in · 2 the change
note: The one decision of the week, as a ▶ menu. Before → after in a plain table.

title: Check-in · 3 done
note: Done. The new number, said once.

title: Goal & strategy
note: Goal, pace, coaching and diet style on one page. Fresh start lives at its foot.

title: Calories & macros
note: Today’s target in the hero; each macro as a row with its share.

title: Energy
note: What you burn, worked out from what you eat and how your weight moves.

title: Weekly shape
note: Same weekly total, spread how you like.

title: Weigh-ins
note: The log, newest first. Log weight in the bar.

title: Progress · first week
note: Before there’s a trend: what’s being learnt, and how far along.

title: What’s coming up
note: Holidays, events and rough weeks. The plan bends around them instead of marking you down.

title: You (settings)
note: Behind the gear. One list, values on the right, no inline controls and no search (14 rows).

title: Account & Premium
note: Account and subscription together (the Settings | Account switch goes).

title: Body details
note: A form. What changes your numbers says so once, at the foot.

title: Default meals
note: Reorder, rename, add. The diary follows this list.

title: Reminders
note: Each nudge is one switch. Times are one row each.

title: Apps & data
note: What’s connected, then what’s coming (you can ask for one).

title: Theme & units (sheet)
note: Theme and units moved off the list into one small sheet.

title: Premium (sheet)
note: The paywall: the buddy says why once, four rows say what, one button.

title: Play · buddy
note: Opened by tapping Chompers. Terrarium is the hero; Battle and Shop are the two other places.

title: Play · battle
note: This week’s boss. HP bars are literal here; one Fight button.

title: Play · shop
note: Amber to spend. Each item is a row with its price.

title: Trophies
note: Earned first, then the next few to aim for.

title: Dress up
note: What’s owned, by slot. Tap to wear.

title: Milestone
note: A growth stage or goal moment: the buddy’s scene and one line, then one button. Replaces the confetti modal.

title: Hatching
note: The first-week moment: the egg hatches in a scene, then asks for a name.

title: 1 · Sign in
note: The only place the wordmark appears.

title: 2 · Hello
note: The egg introduces itself in the dialogue box; the familiarity question is a ▶ menu.

title: 3 · Choose your egg
note: Twelve eggs, one tap, one button.

title: 4 · About you
note: Step 1 of 4. Units sit next to the field they change.

title: 5 · How active
note: Step 2. Choices are a ▶ menu, not a grid of cards.

title: 6 · Your goal
note: Step 3. Goal, goal weight and pace on one screen.

title: 7 · Your starting plan
note: Step 4. The numbers in the same hero Today will use.

title: 8 · All set
note: Hands over to Today, where the egg keeps talking.
